name: Air-Fryer Chickpea Patties
ingredients: ¼ cup finely chopped onion and 2 tbsp coriander
2 tbsp whole-wheat breadcrumbs or oat flour
1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp paprika
steps: Mix everything except the oil; the mixture should hold when pressed.
Shape into 6 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C. Brush the patties lightly with oil.
Cook for 14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and firm.
Serve in a whole-wheat bun or over salad.
note: High in fibre, and a good meat-free burger alternative.
